results.content:
DENVER, Colorado — Latino voters in Colorado's 8th Congressional District are broadly pessimistic about the country's direction and increasingly critical of President Trump's job performance, according to new polling from the 2026 Latino Policy Agenda Survey.

The results show increased criticism toward Trump as well as Republican Congressman Gabe Evans, who was endorsed by the president and leaned heavily on that support during his election bid in 2024.

   This story continues below. [...] The polling discovered that 68% of Latino respondents said the country is headed in the wrong direction, compared with 18% who said it's headed in the right direction. When asked about Trump specifically
results.title: Poll: Latino voters in CD8 sour on Trump, critical of Evans ahead of midterms

results.content:
State of play: 61% of respondents in the district said they disapprove of Trump, while 37% said they approve, according to the 2026 Colorado Latino Policy Agenda survey.

Zoom in: Evans, who is Latino, has a negative rating among Latino voters in the district, with 42% disapproving of him, while 34% approve.

What they're saying: Axios Denver has reached out to Evans' campaign for a response. [...] Editor's note: This story has been corrected to reflect that the 61% of respondents in the district who said they disapprove of President Trump reflects a 13% jump (not drop) from 2025.
